entities.name: Agent Tesla
entities.gloss: A .NET-based keylogger, stealer, and remote access trojan used to exfiltrate credentials and system data.

entities.name: RegAsm.exe
entities.gloss: A legitimate Microsoft .NET assembly registration utility executed by the malware during infection.

entities.name: AvqOUjZwpiXQ.exe
entities.gloss: A malicious executable dropped with a pseudorandom name during the initial unpacking stage of Agent Tesla.

entities.name: DynDns.com
entities.gloss: A dynamic DNS service used by malware for dynamic command-and-control server resolution.

entities.name: BaDpDF.com
entities.gloss: An internet domain used for HTTP communication and data exfiltration by Agent Tesla.

entities.name: cm.islamabad@chinagrill.co
entities.gloss: An email address used by Agent Tesla to exfiltrate collected victim data via SMTP.

entities.name: Apple
entities.gloss: An American multinational technology company whose software credentials and keychains are targeted by malware.

relations.head: Agent Tesla
relations.evidence: створює виконуваний файл з псевдовипадковою назвою (наприклад AvqOUjZwpiXQ.exe)

relations.head: Agent Tesla
relations.evidence: SMTP протокол – відправляючи дані на поштову адресу cm.islamabad@chinagrill.co
